scope: Exploratory synthetic native mechanism comparison; not preregistered/confirmatory G03b or a language benchmark.

protocol.classification: Exploratory synthetic native mechanism comparison; not preregistered/confirmatory G03b or a language benchmark.
protocol.freeze_scope: Recipe written before the first local execution. This timestamp/hash is not an independent prior Git preregistration or proof of execution custody.
protocol.model_seed_rule: world seed + 10000; separate initialization generator; replay is deterministic

codec.decoding: Full22-token native argmax; non-value token is explicit abstention

common_prefix.branch_state: Identical copied model weights, Adam first/second moments, step and hyperparameters; no optimizer reset

protocol.update_schedule: For every post-prefix event, train current target the declared number of times, then latest observed replay target if the arm requests it. Initial observations and same-value assignments consume exposure.
protocol.replay_policy: Exclude current key. Choose latest-visible target on same entity if available, then lowest latest-event order/key. Otherwise choose lowest latest-event order/key across other visible facts. If no other key exists, repeat current event and label fallback explicitly. No future labels or stale superseded replay targets.
protocol.negative_control: Each introduced entity has one permanently unobserved relation. Coordinator-only PCG64(SeedSequence([seed,5129033])) supplies random labels in fixed key order. Targets never reach learner, event generator, initialization or replay. This is an unlearnable-random-label diagnostic, not a language/generalization metric.
protocol.primary_descriptive_endpoint: all-assignment phase-end horizon1 accuracy, retaining failed acquisition and explicit censored/not-yet-due/missing counts
other_endpoints: post-prefix new-fact acquisition immediately after its event
phase-end previously observed current facts (latest observation before current phase)
all horizons and acquired-only secondary rates
protocol.cost_contract: Report exact current/replay target presentations, optimizer calls, query inputs, algorithmic replay payload bytes, instrumentation history bytes, parameter/Adam array bytes. Matched-total arms equate updates and total targets only; additive replay spends50% more post-branch updates. No measured FLOPs, runtime or energy comparison. Frozen is a no-learning reference, not matched cost.
protocol.aggregation: Three paired seeds; all per-seed values and denominators. Descriptive paired differences/means/min/max only. No p-values, confidence intervals, winner threshold or confirmatory efficacy claim; do not average away undefined endpoints.
limits: All data synthetic and generated; no corpus, tokenizer or natural-language claims.
No hyperparameter tuning, outcome-dependent seed selection or early stop.
A replay improvement can trade against current-event learning; report both matched-total and same-current-exposure additive controls.
Shared common-prefix pretraining is executed once per seed and attributed transparently to each arm.
Frozen state may answer a changed label by chance; it cannot acquire through training.
Small instance and three seeds do not establish useful scale or a general retention mechanism.

claim_boundaries: All data synthetic and generated; no corpus, tokenizer or natural-language claims.
No hyperparameter tuning, outcome-dependent seed selection or early stop.
A replay improvement can trade against current-event learning; report both matched-total and same-current-exposure additive controls.
Shared common-prefix pretraining is executed once per seed and attributed transparently to each arm.
Frozen state may answer a changed label by chance; it cannot acquire through training.
Small instance and three seeds do not establish useful scale or a general retention mechanism.
Seed summaries are descriptive; undefined seed endpoints prevent a complete aggregate.
Update/target matching is not a measured FLOP, latency, energy or peak-memory comparison.
Arm-level common pretraining is shared once per seed, not re-executed four times.
No failed acquisition or unfavorable seed is filtered from primary results.

full_receipt.encoding: gzip of the exact original UTF-8 JSON output
full_receipt.scope: The full per-event logs, logits, checkpoints, cohorts and exposure records are preserved losslessly. This summary is a view, not an independently executed experiment.
